representation_fit.evidence: Brief shape is temporal-sequence / change_set with high temporality and success criterion '变更因果可读' (brief.md). The app is a literal change_set chronicle: 7 release windows with 21 changes and 4 causal chains (data.js:38-140), left timeline of windows (screenshots both viewports: 时间轴·变更集 v2.8.0→v2.9.1 with transport buttons), middle state-at-selected-window reconstructed by replay (app.js:76-89) with inline from→to diffs, right window change list + causal chain (app.js:237-301). Spatiality 'none' respected (no map metaphor); per-service window strips (app.js:211-220) tie each element to the time axis.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Subtitle states the job verbatim — '服务舰队随时间的状态演化 · 变更因果可读' (index.html:13, visible both viewports); ~half the frame is change-set structure (timeline + window detail) and the middle cards show the current-window diffs and change counts ('本窗口变更 3 项 · 点选右侧变更可查看因果链'). Deduction: the causal-chain panel is empty at first paint with only a prompt (app.js:281-283; both screenshots), so the success-criterion view needs one interaction to appear.

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy. What/where is conveyed fast: three labeled panes (index.html:30,44-47,50-53), a color legend (新增/修改/下线/因果链, both screenshots), a status chip '✓ 时间-因果一致性校验通过 · 21 项变更 · 4 条因果链' (app.js:128-129, visible both viewports), and a hint explaining the card strips and keys (index.html:40). Friction: very small muted type (9.5–10.5px, styles.css:127,154,156) and initially cryptic square strips slow first-parse.

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero modes, one screen: any window reachable in one action — timeline item click, per-card strip square click, 5 transport buttons (index.html:32-36), ←/→ keys (app.js:356-360), or deep links ?w=&c=&trace=1 (app.js:369-374, evidence.md:45); any change's chain in one click from the always-visible list (app.js:344,314-318); full-chain highlight one more click (app.js:287-288,319-324).

context_loss.evidence: Primary actions stay in-layout: window switch re-renders all three panes in place, sticky state header keeps position context while scrolling (styles.css:73), trace mode highlights/dims cards instead of navigating (app.js:169-175,226; styles.css:88-89), Esc exits trace (app.js:359). Losses: switching windows clears the selected change/chain (app.js:310-311), and every render replaces container innerHTML, destroying keyboard focus with no focus restoration (app.js:159,186,277 — consistent with receipt a11y.focus_order fail).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are exactly three purposeful panes + header; controls are 5 transport buttons and a legend (index.html:15-37). No decorative widgets, settings, or dead nav. Only minor redundancy: window metrics shown in both left timeline items (app.js:153-156) and right detail panel (app.js:240-242), serving scan-vs-detail needs.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt (measurement-summary.json checks): a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=pass, plus type.min_projected_size=fail. Source corroborates: muted #8b98ab text down to 9.5px and 10.5px at opacity .75 (styles.css:4,39,127,154), dimmed cards at opacity .35/.55 (styles.css:87-88), no :focus-visible styles or focus management anywhere in styles.css/app.js despite full innerHTML re-renders. Visible affordances themselves are distinguishable (legend, op tags, strip squares).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '时间结构与变更语义一致' is operationalized: app.js:37-73 validate() checks causal order (parent precedes child) and replay semantics (modify.from must equal live field value; add/remove presence), result surfaced as the green chip '✓ 时间-因果一致性校验通过 · 21 项变更 · 4 条因果链' visible in both screenshots; data internally consistent (e.g., metric-agent 0.8.3→0.8.4→0.9.0 at data.js:60,134 matches the 1440px card diff '0.8.4 → 0.9.0'; strip fill positions match change windows).

defects_observed: Receipt failures: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json), corroborated by 9.5–10.5px muted text (styles.css:127,154,39) and focus-destroying innerHTML re-renders with no focus styles (app.js:159,186,277)
At 1280x860 the fleet grid collapses to a single ~310px column (styles.css:83 minmax(310px,1fr)), so only ~4 of 10 services are visible without scrolling (screenshots/1280x860.png)
Causal-chain panel — the brief's success criterion — is empty at first paint (app.js:281-283; both screenshots); any chain requires ≥1 click before it exists on screen
Selecting another window resets the selected change and any active chain trace (app.js:308-313), dropping cross-window causal context on each jump
missing_evidence: Interactive states (chain highlight/trace mode, playback, keyboard navigation) are evidenced only in source (app.js:319-360) and evidence.md recipes — no supplied screenshot shows them running
Receipt is sanitized: no per-element detail on which items failed contrast/focus_order, so remediation scope is inferred from source styling only
scores.overall_note: impl-14 is a change_set chronicle whose three-pane structure — window timeline with transport controls, state-at-window replay with inline from→to diffs and per-service window strips, and a change list with explicit parent/child links feeding a time-ordered causal chain — maps almost one-to-one onto the brief's temporal-sequence shape and '变更因果可读' success criterion; the acceptance seed is not just represented but enforced by a runtime validator whose green pass chip (21 changes · 4 chains) is visible at both viewports, and navigation to any window, change, or full-chain highlight costs at most two clicks with deep-link fallback. No layout defects are visible at 1280x860 or 1440x900 (layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass). The weaknesses are concentrated in accessibility — 3 of 7 receipt checks fail (contrast, focus_order, min_projected_size), consistent with 9.5–10.5px muted type, dimmed-card opacities, and focus-destroying re-renders — plus the fact that causality, the success criterion, is empty until the first click. All understandability judgments here are model-judged proxies from screenshots and source; no human preference or timing claim is made.
